Problem Statement

SMBs are invisible online.

Not because they lack quality, but because nobody has fixed the system. Valuable products go unnoticed because search algorithms are not optimized for small and medium businesses.

Invisible online

Lost revenue

Misaligned algorithms

Search algorithms are not optimized for the way SMBs actually present themselves.
